headline: Committee to review winter warming shelter status, charitable food distribution at Cotton St, and a public safety improvement policy framework.
summary: The committee will hear updates on the winter warming shelter run by Seeds of Hope, discuss food distribution at Cotton St and possible policy tools, and review a public safety policy framework covering public spaces, unsheltered homelessness, and regional cooperation. The Fire Department will also give a public safety update. No public comment will be taken on these items.
items: Winter Warming Shelter Update (Maggie McLoughlin, HHS Director)
Charitable Food Distribution Discussion (Greg Jordan, Assistant City Manager)
Public Safety Improvement Policy Framework Update (Greg Jordan, Assistant City Manager)
Public Safety Update (Chad Johnston, Fire Chief)
